claims.statement: 186 orders allocated to east node are stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup' state since approximately 06:00
All stuck orders are flagged by the overnight allocator as split-reservation exceptions
Allocation rule set v18 went live at 22:00 yesterday and changed multi-node order stock reservation to east-node-first
Temporal correlation exists between v18 deployment at 22:00 and incident start at 06:00, with all stuck orders being routed to east node and flagged as split-reservation exceptions
claims.limitation: Correlation does not establish causation; allocation totals reconcile and regression suite was green

claims.statement: Carrier operations cannot see why carriers are not collecting the stuck orders; dock schedule shows nothing obvious
claims.limitation: Carrier ops has limited visibility into order format or carrier-side confirmation state

next_action.rationale: The common denominator across all 186 stuck orders is that they are flagged as split-reservation exceptions by the allocator. Understanding the definition, trigger conditions, and carrier-impact of this flag is essential to determine whether the v18 allocation rule change is producing a format or validation issue that prevents carrier pickup. This diagnostic is read-only and will clarify if the mechanism is allocation_rule_defect or another root cause.
